status: declared before any canton result; owner (16 Nov): 'Sure, let's try' (basin cantons / river frontiers, workstream A3 of reports/GEOGRAPHY_CONTROL_PLAN_20261107.md)
question: Do real borders follow watershed divides more than control v2.1 does, and does deciding control per small drainage basin (canton) move the modelled borders onto divides without losing accuracy?

data.basins: HydroBASINS v1c standard (Lehner & Grill 2013, HydroSHEDS), levels 7 and 8, Europe, Asia and Africa tiles; downloaded 2026-11-16 to data/cache/hydrobasins; not redistributed
data.rasterisation: each window cell takes the HYBAS_ID of the polygon containing its centre (0 = none)
data.divide_cells: land cells with a 4-neighbour land cell of a different basin at the same level

rules.v21: control v2.1 territory as in plan_A3 prep (held within 2 year-round days of staffed towns and kept roads, plus every enclosed pocket)
rules.canton: every land cell of a basin takes the basin's majority: territory if at least half of the basin's land cells are v2.1 territory, else not; cells in no basin keep v2.1

scores.accuracy: balanced accuracy against Cliopatria extents inside the 15-day band (geography_control_a.balanced_accuracy)
scores.divide_enrichment: share of border cells on a divide over the share in land within 33 cells of the border (geography_control_a2.enrich); computed for the real extent, v2.1 and the canton rule at the selected level
scores.reported_only: river and desert-edge enrichment (river frontier diagnostic, workstream E), boundary cells per territory cell, small-patch circularity

development.pools: rome (Hanson AD 150, Itiner-e roads; Roman empire AD 150) and han (AD 2), both seen
development.level_choice: of levels 7 and 8, the one with the lower mean divide_distance over the two dev pools among those with canton balanced accuracy >= v2.1 - 0.01 in both; if neither qualifies the blind test is not run and the owner is told
development.reproduction_note: the dev windows and the Hanson source were rebuilt in this container (Hanson from the OxREP CSV export); A3 dev scores reproduce within 0.003 (rome v2.1 0.8485 vs 0.849 recorded, han 0.6628 vs 0.664): output/basin_cantons_20261116/a3_dev_reproduction.json

blind.T6_ming_1400: CHGIS V6 county seats alive in AD 1400, Han window, no roads; target = every Cliopatria polity alive in 1400
blind.T7_tang_late_900: CHGIS V6 county seats alive in AD 900, Han window, no roads; target = every Cliopatria polity alive in 900
blind.T8_bosker_1200: Bosker, Buringh & van Zanden (2013) cities with population > 0 in 1200, Rome window with Itiner-e roads (as T5); target = every Cliopatria polity alive in 1200
blind.note: none of these years has been used for any control test (used: CHGIS 742, 1080, 1200, 1820; Bosker 1300, 1500); each pool is prepared without scoring and scored once

blind_gates.G1: canton balanced accuracy >= v2.1's - 0.01 in all three blind pools
blind_gates.G2: canton divide_distance < v2.1's in at least two of the three blind pools
blind_gates.adopt: G1 and G2 pass: the canton rule is Earth-validated and is offered for the map, which first needs map drainage basins (map basins from the height map; a separate step reported to the owner). Otherwise v2.1 stays and the result is reported.
